'''Zirohu''' is the [[List of Arten cities by population|most populous city]] in [[Areoix Lie]] and second most populated in the world, It is located at the epicenter of [[Asnaria]] on [[Zirohu Harbor]], one of the world's largest natural harbors. With an estimated 32.514,000 million residents within the city limits as of 1760, it is [[List of Arten cities by population|the most populous city in]] [[List of Arten cities by population|Areoix Lie]]. The city has an ethnically and culturally diverse population, and is the largest metropolitan area in [[Areoix Lie]] by both population and urban area. Until recently Zirhou was an [[Kingdom of Zirohu|independent City State]] until the [[Ziroher Revolution]] where it [[Zuraher Reintergration|rejoined Areoix Lie.]] [[Zirohu|Zirhou]] is a global center of [[Financial District, Zirohu|finance]] and [[Economy of Zirohu|commerce]], [[Culture of Zirohu|culture]], technology, entertainment and [[Mass media in Zirohu|media]], academics and scientific output
